mapper.select:
WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.MohwResrceClMapper.selectDesirClList(보건복지부 욕구분류조회) */ V_CMMNS_MLSFC AS ( /* 복지부욕구중분류 조회 */ SELECT RPAD(SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,0,3), 7, '0') AS LCLAS_VL_CD /* 보건복지부욕구대분류구분코드값 */ , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS MLSFC_VL_CD /* 보건복지부욕구중분류구분코드값 */ FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LCLAS AS ( /* 복지부욕구대분류 조회 */ SELECT T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS LCLAS_VL_CD /* 보건복지부욕구대분류구분코드값 */ , NULL AS MLSFC_VL_CD /* 보건복지부욕구중분류구분코드값 */ FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LIST AS ( SELECT T1.LCLAS_VL_CD AS MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 보건복지부욕구대분류구분코드값 */ , T1.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 보건복지부욕구중분류구분코드값 */ , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD) AS LCLAS_VL_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD) AS MLSFC_VL_CNT FROM ( SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_MLSFC T11 UNION ALL SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_LCLAS T11 ) T1 WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD ORDER BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD ) SELECT T.MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD AS MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 보건복지부욕구대분류구분코드값 */ , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_NM , T.MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD AS MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 보건복지부욕구중분류구분코드값 */ , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD ) AS MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_NM FROM V_CMMNS_LIST T WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((T.LCLAS_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T.LCLAS_VL_CNT >1 AND T.MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD IS NOT NULL))
AND NVL(T.MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{MOHW_DESIR_LCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(T.MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{MOHW_DESIR_MLSFC_SE_CD} || '%'
